parameters.help_en:
The list of check annotations.


For some third-party systems, code quality detection results may be obtained. To display the results, you can write the information to the check run through annotations by calling the API.
In an update operation, annotation information is only appended. Avoid writing duplicate annotations
parameters.help_zh:
检查注释列表


对于某些三方系统，可能会获得代码质量检测结果，若希望进行展示，可通过API将信息通过annotation写入到check run中
在更新操作中，annotations信息只会新增，所以在使用时，尽量不要重复写入

parameters.help_en:
The conclusion. Valid values:

cancelled: The check run is cancelled.
failure: The check run failed.

success: The check run succeeded.
skipped: The check run is skipped, which is considered a success.
timed_out: The check run timed out
